faqs.question: How do I start a bathroom remodeling project?
faqs.answer: Start by sharing your goals, location and photos through the project inquiry. Erik reviews the brief so the first conversation can focus on what needs to change.

faqs.question: Are design and selections part of the planning phase?
faqs.answer: Yes. The paid design phase covers floorplans, selections and project renderings before construction. Discuss the deliverables for your particular scope during consultation.
